messages:
omar: Heads-up: ACME replayed a backfill overlapping our nightly batch; ledger shows negative deltas and some customers got temporary double credits. Can someone triage?

katie: Do we have sample payloads? Likely duplicate usage with new event_ids on retries.

acme-ing-engineer: Sorry  we retried on 429s and our backfill re-posted ~3k events with fresh uuids. Sample: ```json
{"customer_id":"cust-42","usage":1200,"timestamp":"2026-03-12T00:00:00Z","event_id":"evt-ABCD1234"}
```

claire: Reconciliation shows same entitlement fingerprint but different event_ids so our dedupe missed them. ~14 accounts affected, net negative deltas.

sam: Support has two customers paused. Need ETA and a short customer note.

omar: Plan: (1) create exception ticket for Billing Ops to reconcile & apply manual reversals, (2) add ingest guard to reject partner replays without a replay_id header (return 422), (3) add partner replay runbook. @billing-ops-bot create-ticket.

billing-ops-bot: New exception ticket EX-2026-342 created and assigned to @claire. SLA: 48h.

claire: I'll take EX-2026-342. Need partner CSV of event_ids and timestamps to match ledger. Dry-run reconcile first; if net < 0 queue manual reversal with audit ids.

acme-ing-engineer: CSV sent to Claire's email and we've disabled the backfill. We'll add a replay_id header and stop generating new uuids on retries. Apologies.

katie: I'll implement short-term ingest guard: detect replay window + no replay_id -> reject 422 with clear error. Also add an alert for replay_rate spike. Target patch in next 2-3 hours.

sam: Drafting customer-facing note with apology, impact, remediation and ETA. Will post to #support-drafts shortly.

claire: Dry-run complete: 14 accounts, total over-credited tokens ~18,400. Posting SQL diff and reversal plan to EX-2026-342 before applying.

omar: Recap: @acme-ing-engineer sent CSV and disabled backfill, @katie will patch ingest guard, @claire will apply reversals, @sam will publish note. I'll follow up with ACME PM to update integration checklist.

katie: We'll also update Partner Integration Spec to require replay_id header and include example curl.

claire: Applied manual reversals and attached audit ids to EX-2026-342. Keeping ticket open 48h for verification.

sam: Two customers acknowledged and unpaused features.

omar: ACME rolled out replay_id and fixed retry behavior. Closing loop; monitor EX-2026-342 for final verification. :thumbsup:
